questions.title: Share of children who die before age five in India
questions.hint: Vaccines, clean water, and treatment for diarrheal disease all reach children first.
questions.explanation: It fell to 3.3% in 2020, from 24.2% in 1960.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Cigarettes sold per adult per day in the United States
questions.hint: This century brought higher tobacco taxes, indoor smoking bans, and the rise of e-cigarettes.
questions.explanation: It fell to 2.4 in 2020, from 5.7 in 2000.

source.attribution: US CDC, Office on Smoking and Health

questions.title: Average number of children per woman in France
questions.hint: Fertility tends to respond to education, urban living, contraception, and the cost of raising children.
questions.explanation: It fell to 1.8 in 2020, from 2.7 in 1960.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Annual population growth rate in the world
questions.hint: Growth depends on births minus deaths, plus migration. It can be negative.
questions.explanation: It went from 1.7% in 1950 to a high of 2.1% in 1965, then ended at 0.9% in 2020.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Life expectancy at birth in Russia
questions.hint: Think about what the collapse of the Soviet Union in 1991 did to Russian health.
questions.explanation: It went from 68.3 years in 1960 to a low of 64.0 years in 1995, then ended at 71.2 years in 2020.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects
